• People want praise, so they highlight the work they’re doing well & hide problems

But at Jensen’s Nvidia you could email 1000+ people at once to force information to flow outside of an org that might be suppressing it. I jokingly call email at NVIDIA a “mosh pit”.

He was always chasing information that was stuck in the corners of the company, always learning from the company he was leading. 

NVIDIA is the world’s largest startup because there’s a founder driving it. Taking NVIDIA from its founder is a mistake.

text:
Representative John Moolenaar said former NVIDIA $NVDA CEO Jensen Huang has agreed to closed‑door congressional questioning about his relationship with Alice Huang; committees are still coordinating the date. 

In addition to the special committee, members of the House Foreign Affairs Committee and House Intelligence Committee will take part. 

Moolenaar said the session aims to determine the extent privileged information may have been accessed and how Alice Huang may have influenced NVIDIA’s policy decisions, and that because Huang is cooperating voluntarily he will not be subpoenaed.
